problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package Alpha: weight 46kg
* Package Beta: weight 57kg
* Package Gamma: weight 52kg
* Package Delta: weight 69kg
* Package Epsilon: weight 50kg
* Package Zeta: weight 35kg
* Package Eta: weight 49kg
* Package Theta: weight 31kg
* Package Iota: weight 61kg
* Package Kappa: weight 30kg
* Package Lambda: weight 46kg
* Package Mu: weight 42kg
* Package Nu: weight 55kg
* Package Xi: weight 54kg
* Package Omicron: weight 57kg
* Package Pi: weight 70kg
* Package Rho: weight 70kg
* Package Sigma: weight 54kg
* Package Tau: weight 32kg

Each truck can carry up to 100 kg. Assign all packages using the minimum number of trucks. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total weight in any truck cannot exceed its capacity.
